Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

- (2) An Indemnity Bond should be taken from the nominee/ dependants of the employee that the payment will be adjusted against the payments due to the employee in case he appears on the scene and makes any claim.  
Interest will be allowed on the balance at credit up to six months from the date the report has been obtained by the family from the Police Department that the employee has not been traced after all efforts have been made by the Police. - GID (7), Rule 11, GPF Rules.
